subject: The 70-day quiet rebellion
preview_text: You're part of a mission to reclaim silence. Here's what that means.
body_paragraphs: Seventy days ago, you chose a different kind of volume booster. Not the one with ads, not the one that nags. The one that gets out of your way. That choice means something. It means you're part of a quiet rebellion — a group of people who believe a utility should just work. No noise. No monetized attention.

We built Volume Booster Pro for exactly this. For the person who opens their phone, connects headphones, and wants the boost without the circus. You're not just a user anymore. You're the reason we exist. Every time you slide that bar, you're casting a vote for minimal, calm utility.

That's why the auto-apply feature is our silent hero. It remembers your preferred boost, kicks in when you plug in, and then disappears. No taps. No pop-ups. Just volume, exactly where you left it. It's the feature that embodies our mission: power without presence.

Open the app today. Check your auto-apply setting — it might need a tweak. Then slide the EQ to your sweet spot. That's your signature. P.S. — The people who tweak their EQ within the first 90 days stay twice as long. You're already ahead.
